Carmen V: Heads-up — i'm about to post the internal release note for 2.22.0. change window: 18:00-19:00 PT. need final eyes on pin wording, KMS audit note, and rollback thresholds. deploy-bot will post the one-liner at 18:05.
Sam R: Draft is in PR: https://phab/repo/PR-5201. I added model SHAs and rbinctl examples. also noted we will rotate KMS key kd-2026-03 after rollout; include advisory for ops.
Docs-Bot: preflight: staging smoke ok. snapshot snap-2026-03-23-1758 created.
oncall-amy: i'll be on standby 17:30-19:30. please include explicit kill-switch, who can trigger it, and an audit log check step for KMS post-rollout.
Sam R: inserted into PR:
```
# pin commands
rbinctl pin --env=prod --model=rdw-core --hash=abc123deadbeef
rbinctl pin --env=prod --model=rdw-core-quant --hash=beefcafe7890
# kill-switch (oncall only)
rbinctl traffic --env=prod --set-canary=0
# audit check (post-rollout)
auditctl check-kms --key=kd-2026-03 --since=now-30m
```
Carmen V: Canary plan: 6% for 12m -> 30% for 18m -> full. note: no cross-region ramps during this change window; APAC is deferred to next window.
Sam R: Rollback criteria (short): ANY of -> 5m error rate >=1.8% OR P99 token latency +25% relative baseline OR KMS audit failure OR >=2 failed smoke tests -> set canary=0 and notify #eng-oncall. If KMS audit fails, escalate immediately regardless of other metrics.
oncall-amy: suggest adding: after reducing canary to 0 wait 4m then run `auditctl check-kms`; if audit still fails, proceed with full rollback. i'll be ready to trigger kill-switch.
Carmen V: One-liner for deploy-bot: "Deploy 2.22.0 to hosted/dedicated. Canary 6% -> 30% -> full. Rollback & KMS audit in internal note." keep it compact.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window 18:00-19:00 PT. quiet-mode notifications to #eng-oncall. will post one-liner at 18:05.
Sam R: hashes locked at 16:50 and PR updated with runbook link.
Carmen V: final checklist: (1) final copy pushed to PR by 16:30 (done), (2) hashes locked by 16:50 (done), (3) oncall standby confirmed 17:30-19:30 (amy done), (4) deploybot scheduled (done). i'll post the internal blast at 18:05 with the one-liner. thanks team :shipit:
